notes: This book relies heavily on the existing aac_extras (no, stop, come back, sit down, be quiet, loved) and activity_images (david, bathtub, cookie jar, street, school, time out, hug, ball). The fringe_11 chosen here prioritises emotional and behavioural vocabulary central to the story arc: misbehaviour, consequences, and reconciliation. 'Naked' is explicitly depicted in the book and is an important, picturable concept. 'Rules' supports classroom discussion about behaviour expectations. Avoid duplicating 'no' (already in core Row 1) and 'time out', 'hug', 'school' (already in activity_images). The board pairs powerfully with the fixed core 'don't like' and 'uh oh' for student responses during read-aloud.
